rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a separately stored copy of digital data.

example.english: I make a backup every week in case my computer breaks and can't be recovered.
example.traditional: 我每個星期都會做備份，費事部電腦壞咗冇得救。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 dou1 wui5 zou6 bei6 fan6 fai3 si6 bou6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2 mou5 dak1 gau3

rows.note: Use this for a reserve person or substitute, such as a backup player.

example.english: We have two backup players for this match.
example.traditional: 今場波我哋有兩個後備球員。
example.jyutping: gam1 coeng4 bo1 ngo5 dei6 jau5 loeng5 go3 hau6 bei6 kau4 jyun4

rows.note: Use this for a backup of road traffic or vehicles rather than a general material blockage.

example.english: There is always a backup of traffic in the tunnel at rush hour.
example.traditional: 放工時間條隧道成日塞車。
example.jyutping: fong3 gung1 si4 gaan3 tiu4 seoi6 dou6 sing4 jat6 sak1 ce1

rows.note: Use this for people or support sent in to help, especially in an emergency, rather than a standing substitute.

example.english: The police sent backup to the scene to help.
example.traditional: 警方派咗後援去現場幫手。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 paai3 zo2 hau6 wun4 heoi3 jin6 coeng4 bong1 sau2
